subject.title: Feature: configPatch in plugin manifest — automatic config setup on install

question: What install-time config mutation contract, if any, should external plugin manifests be allowed to use?
rationale: This decides whether untrusted plugin metadata may modify persisted user config and what guardrails prevent silent provider, tool, secret, or setup drift.

options.title: Design guarded config intent
options.body: Allow manifest-owned config intent only with validation, visible diff, skip or confirmation behavior, conflict rules, and uninstall provenance.

options.title: Keep manual setup
options.body: Reject manifest-level writes for now and improve plugin docs/setup hints so users intentionally apply config themselves.

options.title: Defer to config pre-apply hook
options.body: Wait for the broader config pre-apply validation hook before adding any plugin install-time mutation surface.

recommendation.title: Design guarded config intent
recommendation.body: Allow manifest-owned config intent only with validation, visible diff, skip or confirmation behavior, conflict rules, and uninstall provenance.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete posted the prior design-focused review and has strong recent history across plugin install persistence and manifest metadata.
